summary: No solo still or character poster of any group-d actor in character was found on marvel.com, cdn.marvel.com, d23.com or thewaltdisneycompany.com. The only official images are 20th Century Fox film key art (group compositions) re-published by Marvel. Image contents were NOT viewed (no downloads); descriptions come from page context and alt text only, so each candidate must be eyeballed before approval.
